from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, zipfile
work=Path.cwd()
replay=json.loads((work/'checks/handoff/candidate-replay.json').read_text())
expected=replay['patch_sha256']['patches/source.patch']
with zipfile.ZipFile(work/'review_response_review-480ee3bed43b2640_candidate_v2.zip') as archive:
    actual=hashlib.sha256(archive.read('patches/source.patch')).hexdigest()
assert actual==expected
fresh=Path(replay['work_root'])
rows=[]
for row in replay['changed_files']:
    current=hashlib.sha256((work/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    tested=hashlib.sha256((fresh/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert current==tested==row['sha256'], row['path']
    rows.append({'path':row['path'],'sha256':current,'matches_tested_checkout':True})
tests=json.loads((work/'checks/handoff/fresh-tests.json').read_text())
probe=json.loads((work/'checks/handoff/fresh-room-graph/report.json').read_text())
solve=json.loads((work/'solve/summary.json').read_text())
assert tests['passed'] and tests['test_methods']==34 and probe['status']=='passed'
assert solve['generator_hash']==replay['generator_sha256']==tests['generator_sha256']==probe['generator_source_sha256']
for name in ['checks/after-final/result.json','checks/task-tests/result.json']:
    result=json.loads((work/name).read_text())
    assert result['passed'] and result['exit_code']==0
report={'status':'passed','tested_source_patch_sha256':actual,'generator_sha256':replay['generator_sha256'],'changed_files':rows,'fresh_test_methods':34,'fresh_probe_passed':True,'final_solve_source_matches':True,'source_patch_is_frozen':True,'scope':'Transport reports and evidence may be added after candidate replay; final packaging must carry this exact tested source patch.'}
(work/'checks/handoff/tested-source-binding.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='changed_files'}))
